value.rationale: An aggregate sensing row changes a square star to an overcomplete measurement design. A universal explicit sampling rule quantifies when the pooled observation should be sampled and gives a sharp coupling threshold where a direct hub measurement may receive zero weight, a structural E-optimal design property for every integer dimension m>=2, not a special-case computation.
